Anika (Design): Dropping a few mock variations for the Create API Key flow. Main questions: do we force a one-shot copy only, or offer a downloadable file (recommended for CI/service accounts)? Thoughts?

Josh (PM): Leaning toward offering both: show the key once in UI + button to Download .txt (client-side only). Avoid persisting secret on server. We should be explicit about which option is safer for human vs machine consumers.

Priya (Trust): Agreed on download option. Also want an inline checklist for 'who can see this key' based on role visibility. If a key is created by a service account, it should default to not show to org-level owners unless explicit. We need copy explaining access scope: "Visible to: creator, service principal, and admins (if enabled)."

Mara (Frontend): Implementation notes: download flow is trivial (create blob + anchor). For show-once we render in a readonly `<textarea>` with `aria-live="assertive"` and a big Copy button. We should also include a small checkbox: "I understand I will only see this key once." and disable Download/Copy until checked to reduce accidental loss.

Emily (Accessibility): Checkbox + disable pattern is ok but ensure error handling accessible. When the key is revealed, focus must move to the textarea and the copy button should be reachable by keyboard. Provide `role="status"` message: "API key revealed. Copy or download now; this is the only time it will be displayed." Also ensure visual contrast for the download CTA.

Anika (Design): Copy proposals for the one-shot panel heading: Option A: "One-time key. Save it now." Option B: "New API key (shown once)". I prefer A, shorter and action-oriented. CTA label for download: "Download key (.txt)". For CI guidance small hint: "Use download for CI/service accounts; copy for ad-hoc use."

Priya (Trust): Also require a minimum entropy policy for generated keys (we do that server-side), but UI should surface the fingerprint (sha256) so users can verify. Show a small code-looking line: `Fingerprint: sha256:abc123...` and a copy icon.

Josh (PM): Can we show key naming suggestions? e.g., `service-name/env/purpose` and autocomplete values from recent names. Helps with auditability. Also add a small toggle "Make this key long-lived" with tooltip about rotation policy. Default should be short-lived.

Mara (Frontend): Autocomplete: we can reuse recent entries from localStorage and server-side suggestions. For the download, add an attribute `download="redwood-key-<name>.txt"`. For the fingerprint we can render a monospace element with `aria-label="key fingerprint"`.

Priya (Trust): Policy: when user toggles long-lived, require justification text (freeform) and route that to audit logs. UI should show a small readonly entry in the audit modal summarizing justification and the approver if any.

Emily (Accessibility): Nits: ensure the file name for download is announced by screen readers when activating download (not always possible). At minimum announce: "Downloading key file. Please save securely." Also include instructions for keyboard-only saving: focus returns to the reveal checkbox after download.

audit-bot: audit-log: {"event":"api_key.created","actor":"anika.design","ts":1802468100} (automated)

Josh (PM): One more: empty state for keys list should include two CTAs: primary "Create API key" and secondary "Learn about scopes" linking to docs. We should test copy clarity with non-technical PMs.

Anika (Design): I'll update mocks to include: one-shot panel + download option, required confirmation checkbox, fingerprint row, name templates, and long-lived justification dialog. Posting new frames in ~45m.

Mara (Frontend): I'll stub the frontend behaviors and wire the download/copy + maxlength aria announcements. Ping me if we want the checkbox to be optional for service accounts.

Priya (Trust): I'll draft the audit wording and API flags for long-lived keys + justification. Will add thresholds for auto-approval.

Emily (Accessibility): I'll run a quick screen-reader walkthrough on the preview once it's up. If anything is unclear I'll drop specific wording changes.

Anika (Design): Thanks team. Small UX experiment idea: show a checklist of recommended next steps after create (rotate schedule, add to secret manager, add tag). Might increase security adoption.

Josh (PM): Love that. Let's ship the Create flow updates in the next patch and iterate after a short usability test. :rocket:
